The Football Federation of Kosovo becomes the 55th member of UEFA following a secret ballot at the 40th Ordinary UEFA Congress in Budapest. (AP via The Republic )

UEFA President 미셸 플라티니 , who had been suspended by the FIFA Ethics Committee last fall, announces his resignation following the Court of Arbitration for Sport decision that let stand his ban, shortened to four years which corresponds to the duration of his remaining time in office. The court ruled that Platini was guilty of conflict of interest for taking a $2 million payment from FIFA approved by Sepp Blatter in 2011. ( USA Today )
London football club 웨스트햄 유나이티드 F.C. play the final match of their 112-year stay at the Boleyn Ground , before moving to the city's Olympic Stadium . (BBC)
Kosovo and Gibraltar are elected as new members of FIFA. (BBC)

Fatma Samoura , a Senegalese United Nations official, is appointed as the Secretary General of FIFA . She is the first woman and first person from outside Europe to be appointed to the position. (AP via Daily Mail )
In football , 바르셀로나 wins La Liga for the 24th time. It is 바르셀로나's second straight title and sixth in the last eight years. ( Sports Illustrated )

Tens of thousands of people are evacuated from Old Trafford shortly before kick-off between 맨체스터 유나이티드 F.C. and A.F.C. 본머스 after a suspect package was found. A controlled explosion was then carried out within the stadium. The package is discovered to be an explosives training device left behind earlier in the week by a private company following a training exercise involving explosive search dogs . (BBC)

Spanish side 세비야 beats English opponent 리버풀 F.C. , 3-1, at St. Jakob-Park in Basel , Switzerland , to win the 2015–16 UEFA Europa League . It is their third straight UEFA Europa League title win. (Radio New Zealand)

In association football , 레알 마드리드 C.F. defeats 아틀레티코 마드리드 in a penalty shoot-out to win the final . ( The Guardian ) (Eurosport)
More details emerge on the rescue of 올림피아코스 and Mexico international footballer 알란 풀리도 , kidnapped in Ciudad Victoria on May 28. He escaped by overpowering a captor left alone with him. (ESPN)
